hero.sub: We produce high-impact audiovisual content for brands and institutions that need to communicate with precision and creative force.

problems.p1title: Your brand deserves more than a generic video
problems.p1desc: We craft visual narratives that communicate who you truly are — not just what you do.
problems.p2title: Flexible in format, rigorous in quality
problems.p2desc: Corporate, film, broadcast, live events or LED. We adapt crew and process to every project.
problems.p3desc: Agile management from pre-production to final delivery. Your time is part of the budget.

services.heading: Audiovisual Services
services.sub: We cover the full production cycle — concept to distribution — and also operate as specialist technicians at live events.
services.s1desc: Institutional videos, brand presentations, content for social networks and digital platforms. We communicate your company's identity with precision.
services.s2desc: Short films and fiction projects aimed at national and international festivals. Executive production and department management.
services.s3desc: Corporate, product, event and portrait photography. Images that communicate before a single word is read.
services.s4desc: Video editing, color grading, motion graphics, sound mixing and VFX. The final touch that makes the difference.
services.s5desc: Camera operation, lighting design, LED/videowall technician and stage management for festivals, concerts, theatre and corporate events.
services.s6desc: Colombia–Spain and India bridge. Global-reach projects leveraging active co-production agreements.

awards.heading: International Awards

about.heading: Art without expressive barriers
about.lead: Masala Studios was born with a utopian vision: to create art without creative or geographic limits. The name says it all — masala, in Hindi, means 'a mixture of spices'.
about.body: We believe that beyond impacting those who see a work today, it is possible to create a faithful portrait of reality that can be recovered and studied in the future, like an archaeological find.
about.m1text: Internships at Europa FM (Atresmedia) and LinkUp Productions — Barcelona
about.m2text: AV Technician at PTA Málaga · U22 Festival · Letto Studio
about.m5text: 6 international awards · Yllana tour · Starlite · JC Reyes Valencia
about.founderTitle: Founder · Development Director · Applied AI Researcher
about.founderBio: Senior AV & Spectacles Production Technician. 6+ years as camera operator, lighting designer, LED/videowall technician, backliner and production director at festivals, broadcast, theatre and film across Spain.
